title: What happens when an Auto Loans payment is returned unpaid?
content:
# What happens when an Auto Loans payment is returned unpaid?

This policy of the Auto Loans product category at PCB governs a payment on an auto loan that the paying bank returns unpaid. Each product applies its own returned payment fee.

## Clauses

1. **Full reversal.** A payment returned unpaid by the paying bank is reversed in full.
2. **Principal.** The reversal restores the payment's principal part to principal.
3. **Interest.** The payment's interest part becomes accrued interest again, because the last payment date returns to the date it held before the payment.
4. **Fees.** When the returned payment had a fees part, that amount becomes due again as one fee entry, a settlement reversal, that names the returned payment.
5. **Installment.** The installment the payment satisfied becomes unsatisfied again, so a late charge may follow once the grace days have passed.
6. **Returned payment fee.** The return also incurs the product's returned payment fee, recorded as a returned payment fee naming the returned payment. Each returned payment carries at most one returned payment fee, of that amount, judged from the fees already recorded against that returned payment.
7. Blocking a payment source after repeated returns is a fraud-operations decision outside this policy.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical payment)

A scheduled payment of 450.00 had been applied as 25.00 to fees, 110.37 to interest and 314.63 to principal, and had satisfied the installment due 2026-06-05. The paying bank returns it.

| Element | Effect of the return |
|---|---|
| Principal | 314.63 restored to principal |
| Interest | the last payment date goes back to its earlier date, so the 110.37 becomes accrued interest again |
| Fees | 25.00 due again as one settlement reversal naming the returned payment |
| Installment due 2026-06-05 | unsatisfied again; a late charge may follow after the grace days |
| Returned payment fee | one fee of the product's amount, and no second one for the same return |

## Points of judgement

**Is only the principal part reversed?** No. The reversal is in full: principal is restored, the interest becomes accrued again and the fees part becomes due again.

**Two fee entries for one returned payment?** Only one returned payment fee may be charged for one returned payment; the settlement reversal is a different entry, bringing back fees the returned payment had paid.
